blurb:
Experience Banff with all your senses on this delicious walking and
nibbling tour of Canada’s most iconic mountain town.

Join Joanna... your local Banff guide with 3+ years of Banff food tour experience and enjoy Canada one bite (and sip) at a time! It’s a flavour-packed celebration of Canada’s culinary icons... from coast to coast.

Our tours are proudly themed around the authentic Rocky Mountain Canadian experience — fresh mountain air, hearty local bites, and laid-back exploration. We walk, we nibble, and we soak up the charm of Banff without any pretense. It’s about real flavours, real places, and real stories — all rooted in the spirit of the Rockies.

Our tours are about more than just the food. We offer you a side dish of the interesting history of our incredible backyard.

We only serve alcoholic drinks for guests 18 years old+.
